guide.disabledWarning: The module is off: commands don't respond in chat.
guide.title: Getting started
guide.description: Five steps and your viewers can request songs.
guide.step1Body: In the Basic tab switch Song Request on and save. From then on !sr works in your chat.
guide.step2Body: Create a Browser Source with this URL. It's the overlay that plays audio: without it the queue doesn't move. Use the canvas size shown under the preview.
guide.step3Body: Requested music can get your VODs muted. OBS can play it live without recording it in the VOD:
guide.obs1: On the player source, check “Control audio via OBS”.
guide.obs2: In Audio Mixer → Advanced Audio Properties, put that source on a single track only (for example track 2).
guide.obs3: In Settings → Stream (Twitch), enable “Twitch VOD Track” and pick a different track than the music.
guide.obs4: Your viewers hear the music live and the VOD stays without it.
guide.step4Body: To show the song in another scene or place without duplicating the audio, use this URL. It has its own design.
guide.step5Body: Your viewers see the live queue on this page. !queue shares it in chat.

commandHelp.sr: Request a song with a YouTube link or its name.
commandHelp.queue: Shows the next songs and the link to the public queue.
commandHelp.song: Says what's playing, with the link.
commandHelp.myqueue: Shows the position of your requests.
commandHelp.skip: Skips the song (mods) or votes to skip it (viewers, when enabled).
commandHelp.srremove: Removes the song at that queue position.
commandHelp.srban: Bans the song that's playing, or a user if you mention them.

basic.enabledHint: When off, the commands don't respond and your own commands with the same name (!song, !queue…) keep working.
basic.limitsDescription: So a raid can't flood the queue. You and anyone with full control have no limit.
basic.queuePreviewHint: How many the bot lists in chat.
basic.regenerateConfirm: The current player URL will stop working and you'll need to paste the new one into OBS. Continue?

commands.voteHint: With enough votes the song is skipped. Those with skip permission skip directly.

messages.title: Bot messages
messages.description: Leave a field empty to use the default message (the grey one). You can use these variables:
messages.muted: This message is muted: the bot doesn't reply.

queue.disabled: The module is off: you can prepare the queue, but chat can't request songs.
queue.waitingPlayer: There are songs in the queue: open the player in OBS or turn on “Listen here” to start.
queue.listenHereHint: This browser becomes the player and the OBS one goes quiet. When you turn it off, OBS plays again on its own.

banConfirm.track: Ban “{{name}}”? It can't be requested again.

banConfirm.user: Ban {{name}}? All their requests are removed.

theme.presetsDescription: They change colors, fonts and the background. Element positions stay the same.

templates.empty: You haven't saved any templates yet.

elementHints.video: The YouTube video on screen instead of just the cover.
elementHints.equalizer: Bars that move with the music.
elementHints.title: The song name.
elementHints.artist: The artist or the channel that uploaded it.
elementHints.next: The next song in the queue.
elementHints.queue: A list of the next songs.

elementOptions.videoHint: Without the video the player still plays: it just isn't shown.

elementsTab.title: What's shown

typography.title: Typography per element
typography.hiddenNote: This element is hidden: turn it on in Elements to see it.
typography.applyAllHint: Use this font for every text
typography.marqueeHint: Long titles move instead of being cut with “…”.

animations.title: Song change
animations.description: How the new song comes in.
animations.marqueeSpeedHint: For long texts with “Scroll when it doesn't fit”.

editor.title: Visual editor
editor.description: Drag each element and resize it from the corners. What you see is exactly what shows in OBS.
editor.keyboardHint: Click the canvas and use the arrow keys to move 1 px (10 px with Shift).
editor.canvasHint: The overlay size. Use the same one in the OBS browser source.
editor.layoutsDescription: A starting point. Keeps your colors and fonts; replaces the positions.
editor.layoutConfirm: The position and size of every element will be replaced. Continue?

videoCover.hidden: The cover was hidden because it was in the same spot as the video. To see both, turn it on and move it in the Editor so they don't overlap.
videoCover.overlap: The video and the cover overlap: the video hides the cover. Move one of them in the Editor, or turn the cover off in Elements.

filters.exempt: Filters only apply to viewers. They don't apply to you, to anyone with full control, or to what you add from the dashboard.
filters.maxDurationHint: 0 = no limit. E.g. 6 = up to 6 minutes.
filters.allowUnknownOn: Happens with some unlisted videos. They're accepted and the player cuts them at the maximum.
filters.allowUnknownOff: They're rejected with a message in chat.
filters.minViewsHint: 0 = no minimum. If the view count is unknown, it's accepted.
filters.noRepeatHint: A song that already played isn't accepted again until this time passes. 0 = no restriction.
filters.alwaysBlocked: Always rejected, regardless of filters: live streams, premieres, private videos and videos that can't play outside YouTube.

blacklist.title: Blacklists
blacklist.description: Banned items can't be requested. You can also ban from chat with !srban and from the Queue tab.

fallback.imported: {{added}} songs were added ({{skipped}} were already there or didn't fit).
fallback.empty: The playlist is empty. Add songs or import a YouTube playlist.
fallback.clearConfirm: Remove every song from the fallback playlist?
